newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana Land says 3rd Algeria 405 well succesful.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana Land says 3rd Algeria 405 well succesful.

text.p: The third Algerian well drilled by Louisiana Land and Exploration Co, Algeria's Sonatrach and Canada's Talisman Energy Inc has been tested succesfully, LL&E said in a statement.

The MLN-3 exploratory well on Block 405 in the Ghadames Basin of Algeria has a lower gas to oil ratio than the previous two wells, testing at a rate of 1,387 barrels of 44.7 degree API gravity oil , 2.1 million cubic feet of natural gas and 226 barrels of water per day.
The well was drilled to 12,828 feet.

LL&E said that it will conduct 3-D seismic tests over Block 405 and the same drilling rig used to drill the three MLN wells will be used to drill the next well on Block 405, 18.6 miles northeast of the MLN-1 well, starting in mid-May.
LL&E said a second drilling rig has been secured to drill the first wildcat exploratory well on Block 215 and drilling there will start in June.
LL&E has 65 percent of Block 405, Talisman 35 percent and Sonatrach the option to participate in the development and production of commercial discoveries.
